### T-063 — blong-browser model CRUD Playwright tests are flaky on first attempt

> _2026-08-21 · core/blong-browser · open_

The generic blong-browser model CRUD Playwright tests (`model.ts`) are flaky on first attempt —
screenshot/timing related, passing on retry — observed in blong-access ("create access
role/capability", "cleanup access user") and in blong-party. Worth a retry/stability pass.

### T-064 — Wood theme items deferred during the design-match pass

> _2026-09-12 · core/blong-browser · open_

Four things were deliberately left undone in the wood-theme design-match work, none of them
requested and all chosen for scope. The Habitat grid stays `repeat(4, 1fr)` sized by its container,
so its column pitch (165.6 CSS px in `editor--wood`) is wider than the reference's ~122 px; that is
a card-width difference (reference cards ≈532 px, the story's ≈578 to 662), not a styling one, so do
not "fix" it by switching to content-sized columns without re-measuring. `.blong-inspector__body`
keeps a `max-height` plus scroll (raised to 420px with a thin warm scrollbar) although the reference
shows no scroll container at all, because removing it would let very large JSON dumps push the plate
arbitrarily tall. The inspector's wood margin is `0.7rem/0.8rem` (≈11.2 px) against the reference's
≈11 px, which is fine, but if the plate padding is ever changed, `:last-child`'s `flex: 1` makes the
change invisible except in that margin. Finally, row/table hover and `p-highlight` colours are
interpolated from the design's static pixels, because the reference has no hover state to measure.

### T-069 — PrimeReact's theme cascade resets structural geometry; wood is patched

> _2026-09-12 · core/blong-browser · open_

`primereact/resources/primereact.min.css` is now an explicitly empty stub ("has been deprecated …
included in the build as an empty file") and the real structural CSS is injected by each component
inside `@layer primereact`, while `themeRegistry` injects `theme.css` separately. Some of those
theme rules use shorthands that reset geometry the structural sheet set — the ActionHint caret
(`.p-overlaypanel:before { border: solid transparent }` wiping `border-width: 10px`) is the one
found so far.

Only the wood variant is worked around, by restating
`.blong-theme-wood .p-overlaypanel::before/::after` unlayered with `!important`. The glass variant
and every stock PrimeReact theme still render a nub instead of a caret. The proper fix is either to
inject `theme.css` into `@layer primereact` before the structural sheet, or to raise the structural
layer's priority — worth doing centrally rather than per variant. Audit other components for the
same pattern, meaning any theme rule that sets a `border`, `margin` or `padding` shorthand over a
structural rule: `p-overlaypanel::before/after` is the only caret in this app today, but Tooltip,
ConfirmPopup and others may have equivalents.

### T-070 — ActionButton's error state is wired to a hard-coded 2000 ms

> _2026-09-12 · core/blong-browser · open_

`ActionButton` sets `blong-action-error` for a hard-coded 2000 ms, mirroring `ActionHint`'s
auto-dismiss, rather than tracking the hint's actual lifecycle. That is fine today, but if the hint
duration ever becomes configurable, the two will drift.

### T-098 — Pivot dropdown lists load every option; add paging/search for large record sets

> _2026-09-16 · core/blong-browser · open_

A pivot materialises all dropdown options as rows and the dropdowns are unpaged, so an ACL list over
a large record universe (persons, invoices) is unusable - which is why the design puts scopes in the
pivot and per-record exceptions on a searchable page. A searchable, server-paged multi-select (or a
paged dropdown) would let the pivot itself handle long lists.

### T-117 — useDarkMode now has no consumer in the repository

> _2026-09-21 · core/blong-browser · open_

The diagram renderer was its only use, and it now reads the palette from the theme system instead
(D-238). The hook is still exported from the package root with its own tests, so it is a public
utility with no caller in-tree: either retire it, or wire it to the theme so its toggle drives the
palette (which is what its API implies and what nothing currently does - nothing writes its
localStorage key). Left alone rather than deleted because removing a public export is a decision of
its own.

### T-118 — The theme context value is a fresh object on every render

> _2026-09-21 · core/blong-browser · open_

Theme builds `contextValue` inline, so `useTheme()` hands out a new object per render - the same
identity landmine as F-212, where an object in an effect dependency list re-ran the effect forever.
No consumer is caught by it today (ThemeSwitcher reads primitives and stable callbacks, and the test
probe reads primitives), so this is recorded rather than fixed. A memoised value needs care because
`config` and `option` are rebuilt per render too.

### T-119 — A page taller than its tab is still clipped by the shell

> _2026-09-21 · core/blong-browser · open_

The panel that hosts a page is bounded (flex-grow with min-height: 0) but does not scroll, and
.blong-app clips at overflow: hidden, so a page whose content does not bound itself is unreachable
below the fold - the flow page was, and the digest page still is (its list of digest blocks
overflows today). Bounding each page (D-243) is the fix the diagram needed; a page nobody bounds
stays broken. The shell-level fix (overflow: auto on .p-tabview-panel) was reverted because it makes
page captures run-dependent (F-222), so it needs the captures anchored to something stable first.
